title: Harvesting Model with Threshold
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For dy/dt = y(1 - y) - h, find the critical harvesting rate h_c above which population collapses to extinction for all initial sizes.

steps.title: Find Equilibria as Roots of Quadratic
steps.mathExpression: -y^2 + y - h = 0 \implies y^2 - y + h = 0 \implies y = \frac{1 \pm \sqrt{1 - 4h}}{2}

steps.title: Find Discriminant Condition
steps.explanation: Real equilibria exist only when discriminant is non-negative.

steps.title: Determine Critical Rate
steps.explanation: If h > 1/4, dy/dt < 0 everywhere and extinction is inevitable.
